about: Information Systems graduate from Gunadarma University (2025), focused on PHP development with CodeIgniter 4 and Laravel, MVC, OOP, MySQL, and API integration. Built an internal task management application, a PPDB platform serving 800+ students, CMS solutions, and e-commerce applications. Ready to contribute to ERP development using PHP and CodeIgniter 4.

experiences.title: Project Management Officer
experiences.description: Developing Halcom Dashboard, an internal application to track project requests across Sales, SOA, and Purchasing. Automating the sales pipeline with Deal IDs connecting BOQ, Calculation, and PO & Inquiry workflows. Building Power BI dashboards for Management, Sales, and Finance.

experiences.title: Freelance Fullstack Developer
experiences.description: Built a Kaizen and task assignment application for 15?20 users using PHP, CodeIgniter 4, MySQL, AJAX, and Nginx. Reduced missed assignments and project manager/coordinator follow-up time. Also served as Project Manager: prepared project documentation and coordinated an 8-person team across 3 projects with a total value of IDR 80 million.
